non_empty_results.question: Give me all movies with Tom Cruise.

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { ?uri rdf:type dbo:Film. ?uri dbo:starring res:Tom_Cruise . }

non_empty_results.question: Which country has the most official languages?

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { ?uri rdf:type dbo:Country . ?uri dbp:officialLanguages ?language . } ORDER BY DESC(COUNT(?language)) LIMIT 1

non_empty_results.question: Give me the websites of companies with more than 500000 employees.

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?string WHERE { ?subject rdf:type dbo:Company . ?subject dbp:numEmployees ?employees . FILTER( xsd:integer(?employees) > 500000 ) . ?subject foaf:homepage ?string . }

non_empty_results.question: Which caves have more than 3 entrances?

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { ?uri rdf:type dbo:Cave . ?uri dbp:entranceCount ?entrance . FILTER (?entrance > 3) . }

non_empty_results.question: Who produced the most films?

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { ?film rdf:type dbo:Film . ?film dbo:producer ?uri . } ORDER BY DESC(COUNT(?film)) LIMIT 1

non_empty_results.question: Which mountains are higher than the Nanga Parbat?

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { res:Nanga_Parbat dbp:elevationM ?elevation . ?uri rdf:type dbo:Mountain . ?uri dbp:elevationM ?otherelevation . FILTER (?otherelevation > ?elevation) . }

non_empty_results.question: Give me all actors starring in Last Action Hero.

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { res:Last_Action_Hero dbp:starring ?uri . }

non_empty_results.question: Is Frank Herbert still alive?

query.sparql: ASK WHERE { OPTIONAL { res:Frank_Herbert dbo:deathDate ?date . } FILTER (!BOUND(?date)) }

non_empty_results.question: What is the highest place of Karakoram?

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { res:Karakoram dbo:highestPlace ?uri . }

non_empty_results.question: Give me the homepage of Forbes.

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?string WHERE { res:Forbes foaf:homepage ?string . }

non_empty_results.question: Give me all school types.

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { ?uri rdf:type yago:SchoolTypes . }

non_empty_results.question: Which presidents were born in 1945?

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { { ?uri rdf:type dbo:President . } UNION { ?uri rdf:type yago:Presidents . } ?uri dbo:birthDate ?date . FILTER regex(?date, '^1945') . }

non_empty_results.question: Which countries have more than two official languages?

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { ?uri rdf:type dbo:Country . ?uri dbo:officialLanguage ?language . } GROUP BY ?uri HAVING (COUNT(?language) > 2)

non_empty_results.question: Which bridges are of the same type as the Manhattan Bridge?

query.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { ?uri rdf:type dbo:Bridge . ?uri dbp:design ?design . res:Manhattan_Bridge dbp:design ?mdesign . FILTER (regex(?design, ?mdesign)). FILTER (?uri != res:Manhattan_Bridge) . }

non_empty_results.question: Is Egypts largest city also its capital?

query.sparql: ASK WHERE { res:Egypt dbo:largestCity ?large . res:Egypt dbo:capital ?capital . FILTER (?large = ?capital) }
